scripts.check: pnpm run check.workspace-references && pnpm run check.tailwind-deprecations && pnpm run format.fix && pnpm run tsc
scripts.clean: npx turbo run clean && rm -rf node_modules .turbo
scripts.dev: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@usecontextlayer/platform^... --filter=@usecontextlayer/dispatcher^... --output-logs=errors-only && node --import tsx scripts/dev.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:basic test:integration:sandbox test:integration:claude test:integration:polar test:integration:browser --continue=dependencies-successful
scripts.test:integration:basic: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:basic
scripts.test:integration:browser: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:browser
scripts.test:integration:claude: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:claude
scripts.test:integration:doppler: pnpm run check.workspace-references && pnpm exec turbo run test:integration:doppler --filter=@usecontextlayer/platform
scripts.test:integration:polar: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:polar
scripts.test:integration:polar-webhooks: pnpm run check.workspace-references && pnpm exec turbo run test:integration:polar-webhooks --filter=@usecontextlayer/platform
scripts.test:integration:sandbox: pnpm run check.workspace-references && npx turbo run test:integration:sandbox
